subject.title: [Bug]: Live Docs are ahead of release

question: Should docs.openclaw.ai be latest-main docs, latest-stable-release docs, or latest docs with explicit version availability and schema gating for config keys?
rationale: The source mismatch is clear, but the durable fix changes public docs/release policy and possibly validation behavior rather than a narrow code bug.

options.title: Gate Latest Docs Against Stable
options.body: Keep live docs safe for latest stable users by adding generated release-schema checks or version badges before unreleased config examples publish.

options.title: Publish Release-Matched Docs
options.body: Make docs.openclaw.ai default to the current stable release or add a version selector so users see docs for their installed version.

options.title: Keep Latest-Only Docs
options.body: Preserve main-synced docs but make the site visibly latest-only and add version-aware config validation errors for released users.

recommendation.title: Gate Latest Docs Against Stable
recommendation.body: Keep live docs safe for latest stable users by adding generated release-schema checks or version badges before unreleased config examples publish.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest current-history owner for the docs/config/docs-sync snapshot where the remaining drift is visible.
